blocks: ## T01 - the goods range in the hover box (FR-001, FR-002)
## T02 - the reply and the report

decisions.summary: Goods ends are first amount end x goods_dollars to last amount end x goods_dollars_high, formatted by the existing _dollars range formatter (one precision, joined by '-')
decisions.why: Exactly FR-001 and the request's 'goods_dollars to goods_dollars_high' range, central to high; for a single amount both ends use the same amount, matching the suggested '$1.54-$3.32'; for an amount range it spans lowest to highest, which keeps the range a range.

decisions.summary: The module docstring's goods description becomes the range from the central (geometric) to the high (arithmetic) reading
decisions.why: FR-002; serves the request's 'central to high'.

decisions.summary: One comment on diagram#17 naming the commit and what to look at; feature report written
decisions.why: Answers the requester on the thread the request came from; no behavior added.

decisions.summary: No fallback: a unit missing goods_dollars_high fails the build like any missing key; test fixtures gain goods_dollars_high
decisions.why: FR-001's 'no single-figure path' stated as such; the fixture change only enforces the requested range (GM 2026-09-20 enforcement rule).

decisions.summary: Gated landing via make land / make done; performance bookends N/A; research claim stays NONE
decisions.why: Process and verification of the requested change only; no scope added or removed.
